meta.title: Colorado tax-credit properties awarded 2015-2025, scored by the Market analysis page today
meta.source: CHFA Housing Tax Credit Properties feed (data/chfa-lihtc.json)
meta.selection: Every property in the feed with an award year from 2015 through 2025, a mapped point and at least one home.
meta.score_method: Market analysis engine (js/market-analysis.js) run at the property's mapped point with today's data, once for each buffer the page offers. This is our score today, not a score the property had when it was funded. The property's own homes count in its area's existing tax-credit supply.
meta.not_included: No capture rate or lease-up figures: CHFA does not publish them for these properties.
